crew.overview: In the year 2044, time travel has not yet been invented but in 30 years it will have been. When the mob wants to get rid of someone, they will send their target into the past where a looper, a hired gun, like Joe is waiting to mop up. Joe is getting rich and life is good until the day the mob decides to close the loop, sending back Joe's future self for assassination.
crew.title: Looper

crew.overview: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.
crew.title: Sinners

details.biography: Michael describes himself as a story teller. Be it as an actor, a playwright, a producer or a director, his passion to create new works and to develop new ideas seems endless. Originally from New Orleans, Mike developed a love for the stage and screen at an early age and has pursued his goals and dreams ever since. He has worked as a leading actor, a writer, a producer and director throughout the industry.
details.name: Mike Mayhall
